body:
The text in the desktop app looks too small. Let the human change the font size.

**Behavior**
- Settings → Appearance tab: a **Font size** dropdown whose choices are font size values in pixels: 12, 13, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24. Plus a **Reset to default** button that sets it back to the default size.
- In the desktop app, **Ctrl + mouse wheel up** makes the font bigger and **Ctrl + mouse wheel down** makes it smaller. Each step moves to the next size in the dropdown. It stops at the smallest and largest sizes.
- The wheel and the dropdown stay in step: zooming with the wheel changes the dropdown's value, and picking a value in the dropdown changes the size.
- The chosen size applies to every page and is remembered when the app is opened again.

**Notes for the agent**
- The default is the app's current base font size; if that isn't one of the listed values, add it to the list.
- Settings are kept through `settings.load` / `settings.save` / `settings.subscribe` in `solace-cli/settings/src/store.mjs`, so pages that are already open pick up changes.
- Make sure Ctrl + wheel doesn't also trigger the webview's own built-in zoom in the desktop app.
title: appearance: adjustable font size
